description: Starts a background watcher on this computer that wakes an AI agent when a handoff is ready, even after this session has ended (for example after its usage limit ran out). It works only if the user allowed it (setting modelMayStartWatcher); otherwise it tells you what to tell the user. ASK THE USER FIRST: it runs a command unattended. The command and who is trusted are the user's settings, not yours.
name: meshingly_watch_start
